title: Persistent Pilot Storage Safe Inode Recovery
objective: Expose an owner-confirmed, path-locked recovery action for superseded Blueprint restaging snapshots, with inode inventory and canonical persistence health proof.
implementation_summary: An authorised owner can inventory persistent filesystem entry counts and governed storage classes without exposing file contents.
Recovery is limited to superseded Blueprint staging-history versions outside a two-version rollback window and requires exact human confirmation.
Flora can start in recovery-only mode after inode preflight failure and reports inode, write and minimal BlueprintPackageRecord persistence probes after cleanup.
expected_visible_outcomes: The storage recovery diagnostic identifies the deployed primary inode-consuming family by entry count.
The preview reports eligible files and estimated recoverable inodes with canonical data affected = NO.
Normal routes remain unavailable until the existing inode threshold and both persistence probes pass.
required_test_steps: Confirm the primary deployed inode consumer and that only superseded staging history is eligible.
Type the exact confirmation and execute only when marked safe.
Confirm inode preflight, write probe and BlueprintPackageRecord persistence all PASS.
Upload the original successful TEL-001 package; only then test corrected Wave 6.
fresh_import_policy: YES — test the original successful TEL-001 only after storage health passes.
known_limitations: Production inode counts and post-recovery results are available only from the deployed persistent volume inventory.
operator_validation_status: PENDING — deployed inventory and confirmed recovery required
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
material_runtime_components_changed: Persistent storage inventory and governed recovery
fresh_import_required: YES — original TEL-001 after health passes
candidate_state_impact: Only superseded non-canonical staging-history snapshots outside the retained rollback window are eligible.
